description_en: Queries the status of a trail
name: GetTrailStatus

parameters.help_en:
The name of the trail.  
The name must be 6 to 36 characters in length, must start with a lowercase letter, and can contain lowercase letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_).  

Trail names must be unique within an account
parameters.help_zh:
跟踪名称。  
长度为6～36个字符，必须以小写英文字母开头，可包含小写英文字母、数字、短划线（-）和下划线（_）。  

同一账号内跟踪名称不可重复
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query the status of a multi-account trail. Valid values:  

true: queries the status of a multi-account trail.

false (default): queries the status of a single-account trail
parameters.help_zh:
是否查询多账号跟踪状态，取值：  

true：查询多账号跟踪状态。

false（默认值）：查单账号跟踪状态
parameters.name: is_organization_trail

IsLogging.description_en:
Indicates whether log record is enabled. Valid values:

true: Enabled.  
false: shutdown
IsLogging.description_zh:
是否开启日志记录，取值：

true：开启。  
false：关闭

LatestDeliveryError.description_en: The log information of the most recent trail exception
LatestDeliveryError.description_zh: 最近一次行为跟踪异常的日志信息
LatestDeliveryError.example: write sls failed, exception: the parent of sub user must be project owner, itemscount: 1

LatestDeliveryLogServiceError.description_en: The error message of the most recent fault during delivery to Simple Log Service
LatestDeliveryLogServiceError.description_zh: 最近一次投递日志服务的错误信息
LatestDeliveryLogServiceError.example: write sls failed, exception: the parent of sub user must be project owner, itemscount: 1

LatestDeliveryLogServiceTime.description_en: The most recent time when the trail delivered events to Simple Log Service. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z' format in UTC
LatestDeliveryLogServiceTime.description_zh: 跟踪最近一次投递时间，时间遵循 ISO 8601 标准，使用 UTC 时区，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'

LatestDeliveryTime.description_en: The most recent time when events were successfully delivered. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z' format in UTC
LatestDeliveryTime.description_zh: 最近一次成功投递的时间。时间遵循 ISO 8601 标准，使用 UTC 时区，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'

OssBucketStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether the OSS bucket is available. Valid values:

true: Available.
false: Not available
OssBucketStatus.description_zh:
OSS存储空间是否可用，取值：

true：可用。
false：不可用

SlsLogStoreStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether the SLS Logstore is available. Valid values:

true: Available.  
false: Not available
SlsLogStoreStatus.description_zh:
SLS Logstore是否可用，取值：

true：可用。  
false：不可用

StartLoggingTime.description_en: The most recent time when the trail started logging events. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z' format in UTC
StartLoggingTime.description_zh: 跟踪最近一次开始记录事件的时间。时间遵循 ISO 8601 标准，使用 UTC 时区，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'

StopLoggingTime.description_en: The most recent time when the trail stopped logging events. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z' format in UTC
StopLoggingTime.description_zh: 跟踪最近一次停止记录事件的时间。时间遵循 ISO 8601 标准，使用 UTC 时区，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'
